title: What is agentic AI? Meaning, with an example | 50agents
description: Agentic AI is AI that pursues a goal over several steps on its own: planning, using tools, checking and deciding. What it looks like in a small business.
definition: Agentic AI is AI that pursues a goal over several steps on its own: it plans, uses tools, checks results and picks the next step.
It names a degree of independence, not a product; AI agents are its usual unit.

example.ask: Go through my unread email now, then every weekday at 8:00, and draft replies
example.why: It decides which unread emails need an answer, then drafts only those.
